explication: Arkham Horror LCG is a browser-based implementation of the cooperative card game. Players enter through the web app, authenticate, create or join a game, and play through campaign or standalone scenarios; the interface also supports deck building/import, multiplayer, tarot readings, and campaign records. A separate Arkham Cards MCP service offers custom-card authoring and library tools over local stdio or remote HTTP. The tree and excerpts show the frontend and MCP entry points, but not the backend game engine or most frontend wiring, so those connections are kept limited.
